sourceStatus: literature-constrained procedural assets; not field-calibrated reconstruction

growthOrigins.camphor: buried seed coat, connected radicle and developing shoot axis; hypogeal per CSIRO source
growthOrigins.acer: buried samara/coat and developing axis; epigeal hypocotyl/cotyledon draft withheld after anatomy inspection, not enabled

physics.leaves: bounded quasi-static blade/strip deformation with material coordinates on all seven species; isotropic proxy, not a shell solver
physics.rootSoil: geometric continuity proxy with fixed collar bottom; no anchorage or hydraulic solver
physics.woodLoads: actual rendered tube sections include merged fine shoots; nearest-owner lumping, circular/polygon-frustum approximation
physics.unsolved: off-axis torsion, root-soil compliance, fracture and full nonlinear beam response
physics.validity: explicit raw demand and saturation diagnostics; revised uncalibrated Osmanthus support priors keep the default 3.2 m/s / 1 g scenario within the small-deflection guard; other species/scenarios can saturate

growthRules.scaffold: persistent without an explicit pruning/damage event
growthRules.rootJunction: actual bark basal polygon welded through a short imposed transition to a fixed lower root collar
growthRules.roots: keyed axis identities and fixed material-node prefixes; proximal seed-to-collar extension
growthRules.foliation: persistent fine-shoot material sites; lower-stem foliage uses an explicit renewal prior separate from retained wooden spurs
growthRules.ophiopogon: fixed ramet and leaf insertion material coordinates, extending rhizome precursor before a new rooted daughter ramet
growthRules.localSoilWindow: visual window only; available depth still governs all root growth and relative-water computations

visualRefinement.osmanthus: fixed supplemental distal leaf nodes within existing 28704-leaf/869-axis capacity; true leaf area feeds support thickening and actual loads; density1.8 has no spare allocation
visualRefinement.camphorAcer: fixed curved material axes with parent-tangent-oriented descendants
visualRefinement.iris: ribbed fans, curved falls, white fringed crests and procedural vein pigment
visualRefinement.herbRoots: fixed Ophiopogon clone nodes and material-prefix roots; actual surface-node root starts and basal bridges
visualRefinement.ginkgo: complete-catalogue spread of connected short-shoot modules, fixed site identities and original leaf dimensions; remaining crown gaps are not field-calibrated
visualRefinement.framing: cached occupied geometry with bounded compound joint/blade displacement; root close-up hides soil and frames actual roots; manual camera ownership retained
visualRefinement.soil: shallow local herb root-zone window contains all drawn roots, independently labelled from available soil depth; reduced repetitive macrotexture contrast; illustrative strata, no campus soil measurement
visualRefinement.herbReproduction: Iris/Oxalis stalk emergence, petal decline, drying and gradual collapse annual proxy; living vegetative axes retained; no reproductive mass, capsules or dispersal solver
visualRefinement.shortPortrait: expanded viewer captions and root-zone depth labels avoid the central model at <=700px width/height
